text:
Substance J takes part in a redox reaction.
In the reaction, J gains electrons.
Which statement is correct?
A
J is the oxidising agent and it is oxidised in the reaction.
B
J is the oxidising agent and it is reduced in the reaction.
C
J is the reducing agent and it is oxidised in the reaction.
D
J is the reducing agent and it is reduced in the reaction.

options.label: A
options.text: J is the oxidising agent and it is oxidised in the reaction.

options.label: B
options.text: J is the oxidising agent and it is reduced in the reaction.

options.label: C
options.text: J is the reducing agent and it is oxidised in the reaction.

options.label: D
options.text: J is the reducing agent and it is reduced in the reaction.
